summary: Regional SAR-ES blizzard deployment in northeast Colorado: Logan County OEM requested five CO4x4RNR teams, regional ESF-9 SAR operations center activated in Sterling; 10 missions assigned across Logan, Washington, and Yuma counties (3 abandoned to impassable roads); 11 persons and 3 dogs rescued; teams also checked 23 additional stranded vehicles encountered en route.
responding_agency: Colorado 4x4 Rescue and Recovery (requested by Logan County Office of Emergency Management)
notes: Overnight operation Fri 2018-04-13 into Sat 2018-04-14 (demobilized just after 5 AM); missions also in Washington and Yuma counties. 3 of 10 missions abandoned to impassable roads. In scope per id-3369/3345 mass vehicle-assist precedent.
